# Jayson Cain, Mortgage Loan Originator (Los Angeles)

> Jayson Cain is a mortgage loan originator in Los Angeles, California (NMLS #2270200), brokering loans through HP Mortgage LLC (NMLS #1456273). He also invests in real estate. He mainly helps rental property investors (DSCR loans, short-term rentals, small portfolios) and self-employed borrowers (bank statement loans), and also works with first-time buyers and homeowners refinancing. Licensed for property in California only.

## How he works
- Teaches first: explains which programs may fit and why, in plain English.
- Free first call with no obligation. Sending an inquiry does not affect credit.
- Offers a second look at Loan Estimates people already have from other lenders.

## Loan programs he explains
- DSCR loans: qualify a rental property on its rent compared with the payment, not personal income.
- Bank statement loans: qualify self-employed borrowers on 12 or 24 months of deposits instead of tax returns.
- Conventional, FHA, VA and jumbo loans.
- Refinance and cash-out refinance.
- Reverse mortgages (HECM) for homeowners 62 and older.
